prompts.name: wardrobe
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hero COSTUME SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 4 columns x2 rows, 2048x1536. Same young male in reference, spiky brown tied hair, thick eyebrows, large eyes, NO beard. Same full-body relaxed standing pose, all complete feet/head with 10% margins. 2.2 heads tall super chibi. Flat solid MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no shadows no text no cell borders. Top row MILITARY careers left to right: 0 recruit plain gray linen tunic red neck scarf cloth belt no armor; 1 junior officer simple brown leather vest armor small red scarf; 2 captain bronze lamellar armor red half-cape modest helmet allowing same hair; 3 general rich gold-bronze armor red full cloak ornate small crown. Bottom row CIVIL careers left to right: 0 commoner apprentice cream linen robe brown sash no hat; 1 clerk muted tan robe cloth scholar headband holding bamboo slips; 2 magistrate teal-green wide-sleeve robe black official hat belt seal; 3 senior minister deep indigo-purple robe gold edging tall official hat jade belt. Face identity invariant across all 8. Each sprite centered within its own equal cell, no cropping, polished warm cel shaded inked game style.

prompts.name: stage-0
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation atlas EXACT4 columns x4 rows, 2048x1536. FOUR separate activities, ONE activity per ROW, four animation keyframes left to right each row. Each cell complete landscape scene, identical locked camera and background across its row, subtle sequential motion, no text, no labels, no borders, no gaps. Super-deformed 1.7-head-tall cute characters, tiny limbs, rounded mittens, big heads, brown hair young hero matching reference. Warm Three Kingdoms raising-simulation mini-theater. Row1 military organization; Row2 military training; Row3 civil paperwork; Row4 civil farming. Four keyframes should alternate back into first smoothly. EVERY CELL keep characters full body. CAREER STAGE ZERO: HERO IS A SUBORDINATE, NEVER COMMANDER. Rows1/2 hero wears plain gray recruit tunic and little red scarf, no armor/cape. Row1 hero RIGHT carries grain sack to granary and reports to a generic older mustached officer LEFT who points to stacked sacks. Row2 hero RIGHT holds practice spear, generic armored instructor LEFT demonstrates and corrects his stance; hero nods and copies. Row3 hero RIGHT wears cream linen apprentice robe no hat and sits copying bamboo roll; generic older official LEFT teaches pointing to scroll. Row4 hero RIGHT in cream tunic hoes earth following directions of older farm steward LEFT. Frames1 prepare,2 perform movement,3 respond/nod,4 return. Hero clearly the familiar young brown-haired face. Generic bosses have gray/black hair and mustaches so hero distinct.

prompts.name: frames
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Four DISTINCT decorative theater frames in exact2x2 atlas, square1536x1536. Each frame occupies quadrant edge-to-edge, each large central rectangular aperture solid MAGENTA #FF00FF for transparent keying, no scenery no text. Frame border 10% thickness with corners within14%. Top-left military logistics: walnut wood and bronze rivets, small red command banner top corners and grain motif bottom. Top-right martial training: dark iron and gold trim, crossed small saber corner emblems red cords. Bottom-left civil paperwork: carved dark wood, jade blue corner accents and scroll/book motifs. Bottom-right farming: warm bamboo wood gold trim, rice and green jade corner ornaments. Chibi handpainted Three Kingdoms game UI thick black contour soft warm highlights. No huge objects obstructing inner window, no letters. Frames front view no perspective, same geometry all4.
